rawContent: Stop trying to make Matt Lauer happen, Gretchen. #toosoon #MeToo

@TheeNaz @disableddybbuk I’ve shut that shit down with any man I’m in contact with, not just boyfriends - I won’t tolerate it. However, this needs to go two ways: about half of my #metoo stories are at the hands of gay men, so it would be nice if they would shut down each other’s misogyny, too!

@iSpadeRadio Yeah, but face it - almost every single woman has experienced harassment from a powerful man - Argento stands out as a rarity. So of course the reaction isn’t the same. Where are the millions of men with #metoo stories at the hands of a woman? They don’t exist.
